question: Why does the varied presence of all states imply that everything is essentially Shiva?
premises: Reality abides in various ways through all states.
These varied modes do not alter its essence.
Therefore all things share the same ultimate nature.
inference: Because it abides in all states in various ways, everything is of the nature of Śiva.
plain_english: Abiding in various ways through all states, therefore everything is of the nature of Śiva.
